_doc: How each player sprite part is upscaled 4x (tools/sprites/upscale_parts.py). Methods, all local: nearest, scale4x, gtav_dither, gtav, gtav_pinned, animesharp. 'roles' overrides the default per part: head, eyes, nose, mouth, hair, body, arms, legs, other (weapons, hands). Compare them with tools/sprites/face_sheet.py; the choice is recorded in docs/adr/0008-sprite-characters.md.
